card.name: Words before a key fact in overdose text
card.fires_on: Marks the spot just before a specific detail: a space before a number after 'overdose of orally ingested iron is', 'by' after 'removed from general circulation', and similar joining words. Mostly in overdose or removal passages.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The blank space right before a dose figure after 'overdose of orally ingested iron is'.
modes.example: The estimated overdose of orally ingested iron is<< >>300 mg/kg body weight.

modes.label: By before a removal method
modes.description: The word 'by' linking removal from circulation to hemodialysis.
modes.example: Enalaprilat may be removed from general circulation<< by>> hemodialysis and has been removed from

modes.label: Partway through a descriptive phrase
modes.description: A word ending or noun inside a phrase that is about to be completed.
modes.example: in patients with prolactin-secre<<ting>> adenomas is not known.
